messages:
nina: FYI dashboard flagged a big RSVP surge for last week's launch webinar but downstream qualified leads dropped. Can @jamal pull source-level attribution and a quick 7d retention cohort? Need a 2-slide for KPI review.

cameron: Seen this. Early glance: paid RSVPs up 40% but QL rate down ~18% vs benchmark. Might be broader prospecting + CTA wording.

jamal: Running a query now. SQL Im using: ```SELECT source, count(*) as rsvps, sum(case when qualified then 1 else 0 end) as ql FROM webinar_signups WHERE event_date between '2026-03-20' and '2026-03-26' GROUP BY source;``` Will push CSV to the dash.

priya: Messaging note: during the event we swapped CTA from "Book demo" -> "Try product" which historically increases clicks but lowers demo intent. Recommend retarget creative emphasize demo for next 48h.

tayla: Paid mix changed  increased prospecting by 15% that week. CPL rose 25%. I reduced prospecting budget by 10% in the ad doc and bumped retarget. Tracking CPA hourly.

dashbot: Snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/weekly/kpi/1763334444  includes source split and 7d cohort retention export.

nina: Plan for KPI review: Jamal  2-slide: 1) benchmark vs last 3 webinars, 2) routing & messaging impact + recs. Priya  swap retarget creative to demo-first and post variants in #marketing. Cameron  confirm SDR capacity if we immediate-route.

cameron: SDR cushion is 55. If we immediate-route, add failover to `nurture-backfill` at queue>40. I can patch the playbook.

jamal: Added a cohort `webinar > 2 interactions` retention panel and note about UTM parity with partner referrals. Will include short remediation steps in the slides.

priya: Creative posted to #marketing by 2pm ET. Testing CTA variants: "Book a 20m demo" vs "See ROI in 30 days."

tayla: Monitoring CPA after budget tweak. If CPA stabilizes within 48h we keep changes.

nina: Great. Sync at 9am KPI standup. If anything shifts >15% before then, ping this thread and escalate. :rocket:
